files.file.upload.description: Open the file picker and upload what the person chooses. Large files are chunked and can be paused, resumed and retried; identical content is stored once. Takes no parameters — only a user gesture can hand over actual files — and progress appears on the Files overview rather than in the answer.

files.file.download.description: Fetch a file's chunks, reassemble them and save the file. Needs a file in context. A file that is still uploading cannot be downloaded.

files.file.setCollection.brief: Move a file into a collection
files.file.setCollection.description: Put a file in a collection, or take it out of one by passing an empty collectionId. Needs a file in context.

files.file.delete.description: Remove a file's record. Chunks shared with another file by hash are left alone. Needs a file in context.

files.collection.create.description: Name a grouping for files and open it. A collection groups and nothing more — it grants nobody access to what is in it.
